name: hou_mcp_architectural_features
description: Tier 10.5 — Structural Openings & Architectural Features. Accepts the shell_json from hou_mcp_build_shell and produces a complete ArchitecturalPlan (door/window openings, fireplace, beams, wall shelves) plus a full EnvironmentArchitectureReview. ARCHITECTURE_STATUS = PASS only if all anchors are resolved and no floating features exist. Does not call the Houdini bridge — pure planning. Use hou_mcp_architecture_realize to create actual geometry.
